name: financecheck-ai-naail
description: IFRS/XBRL, ISSB sustainability, ESG and double-materiality research; ISAE 3410→ISSA 5000 and PCAOB audit guidance; FT50/AJG4 literature checks. Educational only, no hosted validation.

interface.shortDescription: IFRS, XBRL, ISSB and audit research
interface.longDescription: Research-oriented IFRS/XBRL, ISSB IFRS S1/S2, ESG, European ESRS double materiality, IAASB ISAE 3410 to ISSA 5000 transition, PCAOB audit evidence, and FT50/AJG4 scholarly literature review. Includes source-labeled instructional skills and a separately runnable, offline standards routing aid. No licensed taxonomy validator, formal conformity testing, hosted SEC/ISSB/ESRS MCP, assurance opinion, independently assessed materiality conclusion or automatically retrieved academic papers.
defaultPrompt: Compare ISSB IFRS S1/S2 investor materiality with ESRS double materiality for a fictional company, citing sources.
Explain ISAE 3410 versus ISSA 5000 for a 2026/2027 greenhouse-gas assurance engagement, including effective dates.
Review PCAOB CAM/ICFR disclosure research and find verified FT50 or AJG4 papers with DOI and available replication data.

publication.release_notes: V3.3 adds ten research skills covering ISSB, GHG, ESG, ESRS double materiality, ISSA 5000 transition, PCAOB and FT50/AJG4; 50-title FT50 2026 index and selected AJG ratings. No live standards validation or academic-paper corpus.
